newsitem.title: USA: Numero sees Q2 profits topping $100,000.
newsitem.headline: Numero sees Q2 profits topping $100,000.

text.p: Numero Uno Pizza Corp said on Wednesday it anticipated second quarter profits for the fiscal year to exceed $100,000.

The company said income from the sale of the Indonesian or Filipino licenses were reflected in the $4,900 profit for its first fiscal quarter, but a significant portion of that income will be recognised in the second quarter.
The company said its net operating profits for the first quarter increased by more than $280,000 over the same period last year.
